title: Work, Energy & Power
intro: The physics of carrying water, splitting firewood and climbing hills: joules, watts and Kenya's energy story.

lessons.title: What 'Work' Means in Physics
lessons.focus: W = F × d in the force direction; carrying debe across yard (work) vs holding it still (no work).
lessons.advanced: You hold a 200 N load for 5 minutes: how much physics work is done, and why do your muscles tire anyway?

lessons.title: Calculating Work: Fetching Water and Lifting Loads
lessons.focus: Joules; compute work fetching a jerrican 20 m and lifting it 1.5 m onto a stand.
lessons.advanced: 200 N jerrican, 20 m level carry then 1.5 m lift: total work, and why the level carry counts only against friction.

lessons.title: When There Is No Work Done
lessons.focus: Pushing a wall, carrying at constant height (perpendicular force), orbiting: force without displacement does no work.
lessons.advanced: A satellite circles Earth under gravity: explain why gravity does zero work on a circular orbit.

lessons.title: Energy: The Ability to Do Work
lessons.focus: Survey of forms: chemical (food, firewood), kinetic, potential, elastic, heat, light, sound, electrical; energy hunt around school.
lessons.advanced: Classify ten school-compound energy stores and trace each back to the Sun where possible.

lessons.title: Kinetic Energy: Energy of Motion
lessons.focus: KE depends on mass and (especially) speed; rolling bottle vs rolling stone damage test on clay target.
lessons.advanced: Compute KE for a 1 kg bottle at 2 m/s vs 4 m/s: why does doubling speed quadruple the dent?

lessons.title: Gravitational Potential Energy: Tanks on Stands
lessons.focus: PE = mgh; water tank on a stand is an energy store; calculate PE of a 1000 L tank 3 m up.
lessons.advanced: A 1000 L tank (1000 kg) raised 3 m: compute stored PE and the fall energy per litre — why tanks stand high.

lessons.title: Elastic and Stored Energy
lessons.focus: Stretched rubber, drawn bow, bent stick, wound clock spring; store now, release later.
lessons.advanced: Estimate bow energy: average 30 N over 0.5 m draw — how fast could it launch a 30 g arrow ideally?

lessons.title: Energy Transformations I: Falling, Swinging, Shining
lessons.focus: Falling mango PE→KE; swing cycle; torch chemical→electrical→light; chain diagrams drawn for each.
lessons.advanced: Draw the full chain for a boda ride from food eaten at breakfast to kinetic energy, naming each store.

lessons.title: Energy Transformations II: The Jiko and the Body
lessons.focus: Charcoal chemical→heat→cooking; body food→motion+heat; efficiency preview (some energy always 'escapes').
lessons.advanced: A jiko uses 2 kg charcoal (≈30 MJ/kg) to deliver 6 MJ of cooking heat: compute efficiency.

lessons.title: Conservation of Energy: Nothing Lost, Everything Moved
lessons.focus: Pendulum returns to same height (minus a little); energy bookkeeping; where the 'lost' bit goes (heat, sound).
lessons.advanced: A 2 kg ball falls 5 m into a sand pit: account for all 100 J of energy at the end.

lessons.title: Where Does the Energy 'Go'? Friction and Heat
lessons.focus: Rub palms, feel brake blocks, bent wire heats; friction converts ordered motion to heat; lubrication saves energy.
lessons.advanced: A 60 kg student climbs 4 m of stairs (2400 J) but burns ~8000 J of food: explain the gap.

lessons.title: Measuring Your Own Power
lessons.focus: Timed stair climb with known mass and height: P = mgh/t in watts; compare classmates; compare to a 60 W bulb.
lessons.advanced: 50 kg student, 3 m stairs, 6 s: compute power; how long could a human power a 100 W TV?

lessons.title: Human Power vs Machine Power
lessons.focus: Person (~75 W sustained) vs boda engine (kW) vs posho mill vs water pump; why machines changed farming.
lessons.advanced: A 5 kW pump replaces how many workers lifting 20 L to 3 m every 90 s? Show working.

lessons.title: Food as Fuel: Kilojoules on the Plate
lessons.focus: Food labels in kJ; energy cost of walking, farming, studying; match meals to a day's work.
lessons.advanced: Ugali portion 1500 kJ: how many 3 m stair climbs (60 kg person) does it theoretically power?

lessons.title: Kenya's Energy Story: Firewood to Geothermal
lessons.focus: Firewood/charcoal, hydro (Seven Forks), geothermal (Olkaria), wind (Lake Turkana), solar home systems; mapping sources to uses.
lessons.advanced: Rank sources by renewability and reliability for a rural school; defend the ranking.

lessons.title: Efficiency: Useful Out Over Total In
lessons.focus: η = useful/total; traditional 3-stone fire vs improved jiko; why no machine beats 100%.
lessons.advanced: Improved jiko delivers 12 MJ from 40 MJ of charcoal; compute η and wood saved per week at 3 kg/day baseline.

lessons.title: Project: Home Energy Audit I — Collect the Data
lessons.focus: Survey home energy uses (cooking, lighting, phone charging, transport); estimate weekly energy by source.
lessons.advanced: Design the survey so answers are in kWh or MJ estimable units; justify your assumptions.

lessons.title: Project: Home Energy Audit II — Present the Savings Plan
lessons.focus: Tabulate class results; biggest savings opportunities; present a family energy-saving plan.
lessons.advanced: Convert charcoal kg/week to MJ and trees/year (≈25 MJ/kg charcoal, 6 kg wood per kg charcoal): make the case.

lessons.title: Teacher Demo: Burning a Groundnut to Heat Water
lessons.focus: Teacher-led: burn groundnut under a tin of water; estimate food energy from temperature rise; strict fire safety.
lessons.advanced: Water 50 g rises 20°C (4200 J/kg·°C → 4200 J): groundnut mass 0.5 g — compute J/g and compare with label ~24 kJ/g; why low?

lessons.title: The Work–Energy Link
lessons.focus: Work done on something becomes its energy: lift = mgh; drag = KE change; calculations tying Units 5.1-5.7 together.
lessons.advanced: A 1000 N force pushes a cart 15 m from rest; friction eats 5000 J: find final KE and speed for 200 kg cart.

lessons.title: Power Ratings: Reading Machines
lessons.focus: What '125 cc', '5 kW', '0.5 hp pump' mean; matching machine power to the job (pump head, load).
lessons.advanced: A 1 kW pump lifts water 8 m: compute maximum litres per minute at 60% efficiency.

lessons.title: Project: Rube Goldberg Energy Chain I — Design
lessons.focus: Design a 5-step energy chain reaction from junk (marble run → lever → pendulum → balloon pop...); draw energy-flow diagram.
materials: junk box: bottles, sticks, string, marbles, balloons, dominoes
lessons.advanced: Annotate the design with an energy store-and-transfer label at every step.

lessons.title: Project: Rube Goldberg Energy Chain II — Build and Run
lessons.focus: Build, test, debug; reliability counts; class run-through and judging.
lessons.advanced: Identify the weakest link energetically (where input barely exceeds threshold) and strengthen it.

lessons.title: Renewable vs Non-Renewable: The Charcoal Debate
lessons.focus: Structured debate: charcoal economy vs forests vs jobs; numbers on both sides; what sustainability means.
lessons.advanced: Kenya uses ~2.5 M tonnes charcoal/year: at 6 kg wood per kg, compute wood demand and discuss solutions numerically.

lessons.title: Units Mastery Day: Joules, Watts, Newtons
lessons.focus: Games and drills converting between N, J, W, m, kg, s; common confusions (W for work vs watt).
lessons.advanced: Derive the joule in base units (kg·m²/s²) and use it to check the units of KE = ½mv².

lessons.title: Unit Review: Energy Expo
lessons.focus: Teams run demo stations (power stairs, chains, jiko efficiency posters); unit quiz.
lessons.advanced: Write the expo 'energy balance sheet' for one station showing inputs, useful outputs and losses.
